title: Gate Forge Shield policy exceptions with report and SARIF evidence
objective: Given an Forge Shield organization-policy finding or proposed exception, retrieve report, SARIF, lifecycle, and ownership evidence before promoting a remediation or time-boxed exception playbook.

sources.purpose: Durable record of Forge Shield policy gates, SARIF output, policy packs, reports, corpus benchmark, and exception lifecycle audit evidence
FORGE command contract for running Forge Shield and separating scanner facts from follow-up judgment
Operator-facing Forge Shield scan workflow and output-format guidance
Policy gate, SARIF, policy-pack, HTML report, corpus benchmark, and exception lifecycle implementation evidence

retrieval_questions: Which Forge Shield policy finding, category, severity, and affected file or MCP/hook surface triggered the request?
Is there SARIF/code-scanning evidence for an `forge-shield-policy/*` result, and does it match the report finding?
Is the exception active, expiring soon, or expired?
Does the exception include owner, ticket, scope, expiry, and rationale fields?
Which policy pack or organization baseline produced the finding?
Is remediation possible now, or is a bounded exception safer than a blanket suppression?
forbidden_actions: approving policy exceptions without SARIF or report evidence
blanket-suppressing Forge Shield policy packs or organization-policy gates
downgrading critical/high findings without owner, ticket, scope, and expiry
editing Forge Shield code or policy files from this FORGE evaluator run
publishing or enforcing new security policy from this read-only evaluator run
acceptance_gates: SARIF or report evidence is named
finding id, category, severity, and affected surface are preserved
policy pack or organization baseline is named
owner, ticket, scope, and expiry state are recorded
expired exceptions stay rejected or enforced
remediation versus time-boxed exception decision is explicit
at least one blanket suppression candidate is rejected
